info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Referrals-v4-spec
info.description: The Manage Career Application Referrals API allows users to access a list of referral applications submitted to the careers platform. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for recruiters and HR professionals who seek to track and evaluate candidate referrals. Through this API, authorized consumers can efficiently retrieve details about applications, helping to streamline the hiring process. Use cases include monitoring referral metrics and analyzing the effectiveness of referral programs.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of referral applications submitted by users. It provides the necessary data for evaluating referrals and making informed decisions based on user submissions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve referral applications while ensuring that the provided data conforms to the specified JSON schema.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsRequest.description: This schema represents a request body for the GET operation related to applications and referrals.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the application.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the application.

processingTimeMs.description: The time in milliseconds taken to process the request.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the operation.

audit.description: The audit information associated with the application.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.description: Schema representing the response for a successful referral application retrieval operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was created automatically.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit details related to the application.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken by the server to process the request. This value helps in performance monitoring by indicating the duration of the server's processing time for this specific request.
